Gojūon is the 46 base sounds. Dakuten (゛) and handakuten (゜) voice them: k→g, s→z, t→d, h→b/p. Yōon join an i-row kana with a small ゃ ゅ ょ. を is usually said "o", and ぢ/づ sound the same as じ/ず.

Word lists: JLPT vocabulary from open-anki-jlpt-decks (MIT), ranked with the University of Leeds Japanese internet corpus (CC BY).

Kanji meanings and readings: kanji-data by David Gouveia (MIT), based on KANJIDIC (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0) and JLPT lists by Jonathan Waller.

Sound uses your device's built-in Japanese voice. Stroke data from KanjiVG by Ulrich Apel, CC BY-SA 3.0.
